'''Poached icefish''' was a [[Canapé/Legends|canapé]]. The catering company [[Estimable Epicures]] served canapés of poached [[Icefish/Legends|icefish]] at a reception hosted by the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]] [[Ritinki]] and [[Vop]] aboard the [[Ithorian Herdship|Ithorian herdship]] ''[[Song of the Clouds]]''.<ref name="J15">{{JournalCite|15|The Great Herdship Heist}}</ref>
